sloka: तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूरमितप्रभः ।मित्रावरुणजं तेज प्रविश त्वं महायशः ।। ७.५६.९ ॥
transliteration: tamuvāca tato brahmā svayambhūramitaprabhaḥ ।mitrāvaruṇajaṁ teja praviśa tvaṁ mahāyaśaḥ ।। 7.56.9 ॥

translations.english: Then, Brahma, the self-born one of immeasurable splendor, said to him, "O greatly renowned one, enter the essence born of Mitra and Varuna."
